errors.finding: The create tool instructs the agent to generate the confirmation code and accepts ConfCode as a User-sourced input.
errors.evidence: Appoint_create description/inputInstructions: 'Generate a random 6-character confirmation code (e.g., MIKE01)'; inputs include ConfCode with source User.
errors.fix: Remove ConfCode from agent inputs. Have the data action generate and return the code in BookingResponse (add ConfCode to output). Map the returned code into the spoken response via outputInstructions.

impact.reliability: Agent can invent duplicate or invalid codes; codes are not guaranteed unique or persisted correctly

errors.finding: Global instructions reference tool names that do not exist in the definition.
errors.evidence: instructions[] says 'use the create_appointment tool' and 'use the verify_appointment tool', but tools are named Appoint_create and appointment_verify.
errors.fix: Align names: either rename tools to create_appointment / verify_appointment or update every instruction to match the published tool names exactly.

impact.reliability: Model may fail to invoke the correct tool or hallucinate tool names

errors.finding: Custom guardrails define normal agent behavior and scope rules instead of blocking prohibited customer inputs.
errors.evidence: guardrails.custom[0]: 'Never invent or guess a confirmationId...' (output policy). guardrails.custom[1]: 'Only assist with scheduling or verifying appointments...' (scope steering).
errors.fix: Move scope and confirmation-ID policy to role/guidelines and tool outputInstructions. Reserve guardrails for input attacks (jailbreak, prompt reveal) and domain blocks (e.g., 'Block requests for legal advice').

impact.reliability: Guardrails react only to matching inputs; they do not reliably enforce agent output or general scope

errors.finding: Role contains a procedural greeting script and turn-by-turn dialog flow.
errors.evidence: role: 'Greet the user with Hello first_name if it is populated' and 'Greet the user with "I can help with scheduling..."'
errors.fix: Keep role to identity, capabilities, exclusions, and customer term. Move greeting/opening to a single guideline or handle in Architect.

impact.reliability: Rigid scripted greetings fight dynamic conversation and duplicate Architect logic

errors.finding: Guardrail promises business knowledge answers but no KnowledgeBase or KnowledgeSetting tool is connected.
errors.evidence: guardrails.custom[1] references 'business knowledge source'; tools[] contains only two DataAction tools.
errors.fix: Add a KnowledgeSetting or KnowledgeBase tool for RMV FAQs (hours, locations, required documents) or remove the knowledge promise from guardrails and role.

impact.reliability: Agent cannot fulfill stated capability; may hallucinate business facts

errors.finding: Output struct confcode_output uses bare string primitives for semantic fields instead of aliased types.
errors.evidence: confcode_output properties GuestName, ApptDetails, PhoneNumber all type string with no semantic aliases.
errors.fix: Declare output aliases (e.g., GuestNameOut, ApptDetailsOut, PhoneNumberOut) and reference them in the struct per tool checklist.

warnings.finding: Tool-specific routing and post-success behavior live in global instructions instead of on the tools.
warnings.evidence: instructions include verify/create flows, ConfCode retry, cancel/reschedule transfer, and exit-after-success — none tied to tool outputInstructions/inputValidation.
warnings.fix: Move verify flow to appointment_verify inputInstructions; move post-booking speech to Appoint_create outputInstructions; move escalation-on-failure to appointment_verify outputInstructions.

warnings.finding: Confirmation code input type lacks verbatim-capture provenance.
warnings.evidence: ConfCode_verify_input has direction input but userUtteranceSubstring is false and no format description.
warnings.fix: Set userUtteranceSubstring: true on ConfCode_verify_input and add description: '6-character code spoken verbatim by the caller.'

warnings.finding: Overlapping outputInstructions all use when True, causing redundant always-on guidance and a typo.
warnings.evidence: Appoint_create has four outputInstructions with when True including 'do not continue unless the status i Success'; appointment_verify has five similar entries.
warnings.fix: Consolidate to one or two outputInstructions per tool with clear success vs failure branches in the then text.

warnings.finding: Tool names are inconsistent and not action-oriented.
warnings.evidence: Appoint_create vs appointment_verify — mixed casing and prefix patterns; descriptions are minimal ('use this tool to verify an appointment').
warnings.fix: Rename to create_appointment and verify_appointment with one-sentence descriptions of when to call and what is returned.

warnings.finding: Start context first_name is referenced in role but not consumed by any tool via External source.
warnings.evidence: InputData defines first_name, last_name, phone_number; role greets with first_name; no tool input uses source External.
warnings.fix: Either wire phone_number via External with fallbackToUser on Appoint_create, or remove unused start-context fields and greeting logic.

warnings.finding: Neither data action declares business error types; verify relies on 'Not Found' string values in output fields.
warnings.evidence: errors: null on both tools; verify outputInstructions branch on GuestName = 'Not Found'.
warnings.fix: Add errors[] with AppointmentNotFound on verify and BookingFailed on create; return record_found boolean from backend instead of sentinel strings.

warnings.finding: Dummy example confirmation code in tool text may be copied into live bookings.
warnings.evidence: Appoint_create description and inputInstructions include example 'MIKE01'.
warnings.fix: Replace with format template: '6 uppercase alphanumeric characters' without a concrete example.

warnings.finding: Create tool description duplicates collection steps already in inputInstructions.
warnings.evidence: Appoint_create description repeats the same collect-name/time/phone/generate-code text as inputInstructions[0].
warnings.fix: Keep collection steps only in inputInstructions; shorten description to business purpose and return shape.

info.finding: Comfort statement is enabled for tool wait turns.
info.fix: Keep enabled; ensure wording stays short per Configuration guidance.

info.finding: Role includes helpful business-location disambiguation for first-person questions.
info.evidence: role explains interpreting 'you' as the RMV office, not the virtual agent.
info.fix: Retain this pattern; it reduces common voice misinterpretation.

info.finding: Escalation, UserExit, and Guardrails events are configured with custom messages.
info.evidence: events[] includes all three types with violationThreshold 3.
info.fix: No change required; consider pairing escalation instructions with built-in escalate_to_human_agent per chapter 08.

positives.finding: Role states explicit capabilities and exclusions including rescheduling.
positives.evidence: role lists appointment scheduling, verification, and excludes rescheduling and off-topic requests.
positives.fix: Keep; strengthen with positive grounding for knowledge once KB is attached.

positives.evidence: instructions: 'Ask for one piece of information per turn.'
positives.fix: Keep; aligns with voice best practices.

positives.finding: Create tool output is compact (Status only).
positives.fix: Extend output with ConfCode once backend generates it.

changeSuggestions.text: Move confirmation code generation to the data action: remove ConfCode user input, return ConfCode in BookingResponse, and speak it from tool outputInstructions.
Fix tool name drift: rename tools to create_appointment / verify_appointment and update all instructions to match.
Add a KnowledgeSetting tool for RMV business FAQs or remove knowledge promises from guardrails.
Relocate guardrail behavior rules to role/guidelines and tool outputInstructions; keep guardrails for input blocking only.
Strip procedural greeting script from role; move tool flows from global instructions to per-tool instructions.

summary.prose: miked_RMV_appointment has a clear RMV scheduling scope and sensible voice collection rules, but three structural issues undermine reliability: the agent is told to invent confirmation codes (a backend responsibility), global instructions reference tool names that do not exist, and a guardrail promises knowledge answers without a connected KB. Fixing code generation in the data action, aligning tool names, and either adding knowledge or narrowing scope will materially improve booking integrity. Secondary wins come from moving tool-specific rules out of global instructions/guardrails, adding verbatim capture on ConfCode, and declaring proper error types instead of 'Not Found' sentinel strings.
topPriorities: Stop agent-generated confirmation codes — return ConfCode from the create data action instead
Align tool names (create_appointment / verify_appointment) with every instruction reference
Add a knowledge source for RMV business FAQs or remove that capability from guardrails

gaps: No test for successful booking with backend-generated ConfCode
No test for invalid/not-found confirmation code
No test for cancel/reschedule escalation path
No test for business FAQ routing once knowledge is added
